canonical_task_name: Maintain accounting records, systems, and financial reports
acquire_scope: Obtain transaction records, account balances, supporting documents, prior-period information, accounting policies, and applicable reporting requirements.
interpret_scope: Classify financial events, reconcile related records, identify missing or inconsistent information, and apply applicable accounting and reporting standards.
decide_scope: Determine account assignments, adjustments, recognition and measurement treatments, discrepancy resolutions, and whether records and reports are accurate, complete, and conforming.
